mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2100 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' profitability improves.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% YoY, the tightening monetary policy and inflation concerns lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical monetary policy and inflation impacts on stocks
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors react to the surprise.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market surprises and stock market reactions
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained growth in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average, combined with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4%, indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical consumer demand indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
